_comment: Defects with no code home — tooling, environment, or a fault in a test file, which src-only scanning cannot see. A defect that DOES have a code home is declared with an @broken block beside the broken code instead, so deleting the code deletes the entry. Rendered into DEBT.md; do not edit that file.
